title: nsw-stealth-title
label: Spawn

won.source: Spawn's own bio card (promotions/nsw/archive/spawn-bio-card.html), whose embedded "Flash Back" carries the full script of the cage match at Bone Bash 2003: he hits the ENDCAP (Buff Blockbuster) off the top of the cage on Chris Crosse for the pin.

how: Won the Stealth Title from Chris Crosse in a cage match at Bone Bash 2003, hitting the ENDCAP (Buff Blockbuster) off the top of the cage.
note: The held record ends with Spawn billed for the relaunch house show; no loss of the title is recorded.

title: nsw-stealth-title
label: Chris Crosse

won.source: No record of how or when Chris Crosse won the Stealth Title survives; Spawn's own bio card establishes only that he held it going into the cage match at Bone Bash 2003.

lost.source: Spawn's own bio card (promotions/nsw/archive/spawn-bio-card.html), whose embedded "Flash Back" carries the full script of the cage match: Spawn hits the ENDCAP and ring announcer Nancy Jane declares "your new Stealth Champion... SPAWN!"

how: Lost the Stealth Title to Spawn in a cage match at Bone Bash 2003.

title: nsw-tag-titles
label: Brad Douglas

won.source: Brad Douglas's own bio card (promotions/nsw/archive/brad-douglas-bio-card.html): "He showed up at Bone Bash and won the Tag Titles in a battle royal." His bio names the show only as "Bone Bash," without a year; read as the same pre-closure stretch of the record Spawn's own bio dates "Bone Bash 2003" (presumed, on matching timing — both bios place their own Bone Bash "just before" the fed's own January 2003 closure), not merged as certain fact. No card or results page for the battle royal survives, so it is not structured as its own show.

how: Won the Tag Titles alone in a battle royal, then immediately vacated them — his own bio card's words: "then vacated them to show that he wanted the World Title more."

end.source: Vacated the same night he won them, per his own bio card.

note: As NSW was positioning him into a World Title angle, the fed closed — his own bio card's words: "As NSW was positioning him into that angle it closed shutting his chances down."
